text:
Ana (Growth): Vireo Labs confirmed a case study — 30m interview options next Tue/Thu. Need Qs, quote capture, legal signoff, logo permission, and webinar lead flow.
Ravi (Content): I'll draft a tight Q list focused on impact and ROI. Will include a metrics prompt.
Casey (Design): I can do a 1-pager and a 60s social cut after we get screenshots. Do they allow logo+brand?
Ana (Growth): Vireo agreed to logo + short quote but legal wants exact wording. Ravi target draft by Fri EOD.
Tom (Webinars): Recommend inviting them to a short live spotlight 2 weeks post-publish. Live converts better — I can own the registration + nurture.
Harper (Legal): Checklist: signed release (use template), explicit quote approval in email, logo asset terms (eps/png), and PII redaction confirmation. Anything labeled as metrics must be marked "customer-reported" unless we vet.
Ravi (Content): Draft Qs uploaded: https://drive.redwood/vireo/qs.md. I'll add a consent script to record the quote approval step.
Casey (Design): Can Eng provide a public-safe arch diagram? If so I can mock the one-pager.
Ana (Growth): Eng: please export a redacted diagram. Marta, can you prepare a lead tag for campaign routing?
Marta (Sales Ops): Sure — I'll create tag case_vireo and route to AE queue + account owner. Need final publish date and campaign ID before activation.
Harper (Legal): If customer requests quote edits after interview, require written redline approval. Keep the original recording.
Ana (Growth): Timeline suggestion: interview next Thu, draft Mon, legal Tue, publish Thu. Please drop signed consent in /marketing/case-studies/vireo/ before publish.
Ravi (Content): Got it — will capture two quote variants live and email final to Harper.
Tom (Webinars): I'll schedule the spotlight for two weeks after publish and coordinate CS for panel.
Casey (Design): I'll start the layout and add placeholders for screenshots/diagram.
Ana (Growth): Great — I'll confirm time with Vireo now and send calendar invite with the legal template attached: https://redwood.company/legal/templates/case-study-consent-v1.docx. Update the folder as items complete. :white_check_mark:
